      <p class="section-kicker">Coursework Overview</p>
      <h2>From spatial layers to space-time evidence</h2>
      <p>This portfolio brings together the main techniques I practised in ISSS626: importing spatial data, checking coordinate systems, building thematic maps, measuring point intensity, testing point interactions, and reading event patterns through time.</p>
      <p>I shaped the homepage as a map-based entry point because the work is not just a set of files. Each chapter keeps the code visible, renders the analytical output, and records the observations I made while reading the maps and statistical results.</p>

          <div class="method-chips"><span>ppp</span><span>KDE</span><span>Clark-Evans</span></div>
          <a href="Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex02/chap04.html">Open Chapter 4</a>

          <div class="method-chips"><span>G/F/K/L</span><span>CSR</span><span>envelope</span></div>
          <a href="Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex02/chap05.html">Open Chapter 5</a>

<script>
  (() => {
    const hero = document.querySelector(".home-hero");
    if (!hero || window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;

    hero.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      const rect = hero.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width - 0.5).toFixed(3);
      const y = ((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height - 0.5).toFixed(3);
      hero.style.setProperty("--move-x", x);
      hero.style.setProperty("--move-y", y);
    });

    hero.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => {
      hero.style.setProperty("--move-x", 0);
      hero.style.setProperty("--move-y", 0);
    });
  })();
</script>
